trap-nonspeakable.notes: NOTES for the coordinator (no fix applied). (1) The 'Correctness of the fold involution' section is four staccato assertions - 'The Type-B Cartan datum is obtained by folding. The KLR canonical basis is bar-invariant. The bar involution matches the chirality-reversal.' - followed by 'Thus, sigma is the intrinsic fold.' No connective carries the 'Thus': as written each sentence is independent and the conclusion does not follow from their conjunction. This is a proof-gap shape rather than a language trap, so it is recorded as a note, not a trap fail; the honest options are to supply the connecting step or to mark the section a sketch. (2) The boxed formula assigns rho_F, described as a packing DENSITY, the values m_e and 2 m_e, i.e. mass units. If that is the framework's convention it should be stated at the box; if not, the units are wrong. (3) The conjecture is correctly kind 'conjecture' with a class-axiomatised Lean ref, so the section's declarative 'CPT enforcement is now structural' should be read as conditional on the conjecture, which the prose does not say.
